title: Letting go
summary: Letting go is not giving up. It is placing what you cannot carry into God's hands, then taking the next light step.
graceGuardrail: Release is not a performance that earns peace. Christ receives what you cannot carry before you feel lighter.
framing: This is a short reset for when your hands are full of outcomes, people, or past moments you cannot force to change.
why: The mind grips what it fears losing. Scripture invites you to cast the burden, come under a lighter yoke, and walk forward without pretending the weight never mattered.

steps.title: Recognise what you are gripping
steps.explanation: Name the burden honestly. You cannot cast what you will not admit you are carrying.
steps.action: Write one line: “I am holding onto ___.” Keep it specific.

steps.title: Entrust the weight to God
steps.explanation: Casting is transfer, not denial. He cares for you — that is why the hand-off is safe.
steps.action: Say: “I cast this onto You because You care for me.”

steps.title: Surrender what you cannot control
steps.explanation: Jesus invites the weary to exchange a crushing load for His yoke. Letting go means stopping the fight to manage every outcome.
steps.action: Write: “I release what I cannot control today.” Circle one thing that remains yours to do.

steps.title: Take the next light step
steps.explanation: Peace guards heart and mind after the request is presented. Then move — gently, not frantically.
steps.action: Ask: “What is the lightest faithful next step?” Do only that.

whenToUse: You keep replaying a conversation or outcome you cannot change
You are clinging to a person, plan, or timeline as if force will save it
Grief, disappointment, or control has made your body feel clenched
You know what to release, but your hands will not open
sixtySecond: Name what you are gripping in one sentence. (Psalm 55:22)
Say: “I cast this onto You.” (1 Peter 5:7)
Do the lightest next step only.
prayer: Father, my hands are full. I cast this burden onto You because You care. Teach me to release what I cannot control, and give me peace for the next light step. Amen.

scripture.insight: Casting is an act of trust that God sustains what you set down.
Jesus offers rest by exchange — His yoke instead of your crushing load.
Care is the reason the transfer is safe.
Peace guards after the request, not after you have finished managing everything.

safetyNote: If you cannot stop looping after trauma, loss, or harm, seek wise pastoral and professional support. Letting go spiritually does not mean staying silent about abuse or unsafe situations.
